marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots diminishing to light near noon Saturday
then increasing to northwest 25 Saturday evening. Rain Saturday afternoon and evening. Fog patches forming
late overnight. <br/>

marine.text:
Seas 1 to 2 metres building to 2 to 3 near midnight then
subsiding to 1 to 2 Saturday afternoon. Seas subsiding to 1 or less early
Saturday evening.<br/>
